title: statusline r2 A11y: accessible equivalence asserted, unverified, and contradicted by enumerations
description: Round: statusline amendment cold round 2. Lens: accessibility (validator: ux). Owner: SO session. Defect: machine/human forms declared full-information equivalents, but the machine form's enumerated structured answer (phase, layer, next action, composition, degraded flag, integrity findings) excludes session, work item, milestone open-count — the equivalent forms carry strictly LESS than the segment, and no criterion asserts superset equivalence. Citations verified: contract:160 vs :176, :185. Proposed: resolved-candidate. Failure: assistive-tech operator receives less than the sighted glancer — the alternative-present-but-doesnt-function mode. Fix: criterion asserting every segment display field resolves in the machine and human forms.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in working tree. Superset now verified: every display field the segment renders resolves in the machine and human forms for the same fixture (Status detection criterion); Status bullet states the equivalents carry every field the segment carries, verified as supersets. Revision: Status bullet + Status detection criterion.
